summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The GraniteShares US 100 Autocallable Income ETF (IACL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to generate stable monthly income while offering reduced downside risk. The ETF pursues its objective through synthetic exposure to an index representing a diversified portfolio of autocallable yield contracts, helping to mitigate timing risk and preserve capital over time. IACL was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
